summary: Spinel is a Hearthian fisher who fishes in the Village river just before the cascade. Despite being a freshwater fisher, Spinel loves telling sea-related stories — most notably about Gabbro's first dive on Giant's Deep and the tentacle they glimpsed in the dark.

behavior: Spinel sings rhymes to pass the time while fishing but is not very good at it.
Spinel loves telling sea-related stories despite being a freshwater fisher.
Spinel despises being interrupted mid-story and becomes annoyed at disinterest.
Spinel directs anyone looking for Hornfels to the Observatory, saying they've literally never seen Hornfels anywhere else.
location: Spinel is found fishing with a rod in the Village river just before the cascade on Timber Hearth.
lore: Spinel heard Gabbro's first-dive story late at night around the campfire after the rest of the village had left.
Spinel recounts that Gabbro landed easily on Giant's Deep but couldn't see far down due to murky water.
Spinel recounts that Gabbro tried to dive deeper but was held back by what Gabbro felt as a protective current.
Spinel recounts that Gabbro saw the tentacle of a hideous beast (a Jellyfish) in the darkness.
Spinel believes Gabbro's story despite Gabbro being 'fanciful,' acknowledging sap wine may have been involved.
Spinel encourages the protagonist to bring back new stories for the village campfire.
